Composition-specific Fe-free aluminous bridgmanite material. The ideal coupled-substitution formula Mg0.95Al0.10Si0.95O3 is the charge-balanced representation of the paper's 5 mol% Al2O3 label; same-batch EMP data normalize to approximately Mg0.948Al0.099Si0.952O3 and the authors report no likely oxygen deficiency. The 0.37 GPa EOS-specimen lattice is stored because Daniel et al. could not measure this chip at ambient pressure. Its a\*b\*c product agrees with the printed conventional-cell volume. The Pbnm coordinates are an explicit pure-MgSiO3 topology proxy; Daniel et al. used Le Bail cell refinements and did not publish Al site occupancies or fractional coordinates. The separate fitted zero-pressure volumes and Jackson et al. same-batch ambient volume are not forced to equal the stored finite-pressure lattice.

    - **Volume:** The README defines erV as an error on the last printed volume digits; values are expanded verbatim.
    - **Covariance:** Row-wise pressure-volume and lattice-parameter covariances are not reported.
